# Tanzania OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

National outreach package covering **15 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- Tanzania ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- Tanzania national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- Tanzania public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of Tanzania in the United Kingdom — economic section

## National proposition

| Measure | Catalogue result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 13,854,689 |
| Lines / route length | 53 / 1,145 km |
| Fleet | 2,077 trainsets |
| City programme CAPEX | $10.46 B |
| Local capital and value allocation | $7.83 B (75%) |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 184.5 MW / 1004.0 MWh |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $16.20 B |

Lead with a government-reviewed pilot, local manufacturing and construction,
open standards, renewable-energy integration and independently checked demand,
environmental, social and engineering studies.
